connector.name: Pokes
connector.registryDescription: Poke your human for approvals and decisions during agent sessions - answered with one phone tap.
connector.summary: Hosted at pokes.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.pokes, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your pokes API key> — create one at pokes.dev → Settings → API keys.
